elements.id-string-168: In this paper we have presented a novel segmentation algorithm for wind turbine blade images.
elements.id-string-169: To this end, we have proposed a BU-Net model in combination with additional steps based on hole filling and random forest strategies that can solve the problem in an accurate and efficient manner.
elements.id-string-170: Our BU-Net exploits a focal loss that is regularized with a contiguity term.
elements.id-string-171: The hole filling is simple but effective, and helps to improve the solution after applying every learning model.
elements.id-string-172: Finally, our unsupervised random forest is trained on-the-fly capturing the main patterns, like a denoising step.
elements.id-string-173: Remarkable quantitative and qualitative results are provided on newly acquired blade images, even when they belong to distinct inspection campaigns and wind farms, validating the capability of our model to generalize properly.
elements.id-string-174: Our future work is oriented to extend our model to semantic segmentation where different parts of the wind turbine need to be segmented in the image.
elements.id-string-175: Furthermore, we would like to study its impact on facilitating the defect detection task.
